description: This Java source file defines the class 'DefaultDeviceResolver' which implements CoAP-related interfaces for device authentication and credentials handling within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides mechanisms to resolve device credentials, extract pre-shared keys, and integrate with Hono's credential services.

classes.name: DefaultDeviceResolver
classes.description: Implements device authentication and credential resolution for CoAP in Hono, including handling PSK identities and integrating with Hono's Credentials service.

methods.name: getCandidateKey
methods.description: Extracts the first available credential secret key from the provided CredentialsObject.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Provides additional device info for authenticated clients, retrieving credentials asynchronously.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves the pre-shared key (PSK) for a given PSK identity or server name, involving credentials service lookup.

methods.name: getSharedKeyForDevice
methods.description: Fetches the device's shared key from the credentials service based on device identity.

methods.name: getIdentity
methods.description: Unsupported operation in this implementation; throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: getHandshakeIdentity
methods.description: Creates a tenant-aware device identity from a given PSK identity string.
